reviewer: Kimi main HIGH executor actually viewed the exact 65x67 source and NEAREST 8x source detail, the unchanged full raw-HD return, a native-resolution note crop, the unchanged user mascot reference, and the complete white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha comparison sheet. Checked the actual task/prompt/request/result binding, mascot identity, hair, spectacles, single mouth, clothing, collar, note groups, tab, backing and native alpha.

remaining_reasons: The four-group arrangement is closer, but the return still substitutes generic large round blobs for the source's compact irregular short gray marks. The upper-left and lower-right clusters each contain three large round blobs and the other clusters contain two, losing the source-scale irregular relative lengths and stroke shapes. Restore the source's two irregular groups per row with their compact footprint and relative lengths, not repeated round dots; retain the restored small right-edge tab and blank lower paper.

hair_features.reason: Thick swept-back dark hair, short sideburns, dark brows and round spectacles remain; the chin is smooth with no invented moustache or beard.

collar_fit.reason: The light standing collar and dark central closure meet the rounded chin through a short broad fitted transition, without a long neck stalk, pinched collar or floating cloth.

entries.positive_observation: The yellow mascot retains green-ringed black eyes, round spectacles, one serious closed mouth, the viewer-left pose, light gray-beige jacket and dark central closure. The distinct small right-edge tab is present, the photographic frame/backplate remains, and the lower note is largely blank.
entries.alpha_decision: Native RGBA is 2048x2048 with alpha extrema 0..254. Counts are 0=2120241, 252=1035266, 253=896078, 254=32 and 255=0. White/cyan/alpha comparisons show no visible interior holes or lost photographic backing; internal 252-254 values are not rejection grounds. The visible generic round-note substitutions remain an RGB art defect, so this is not production-approved and no alpha-only substitution is claimed.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine spectacles-rim detail, the exact central closure and readable note glyph identities cannot be resolved at 65x67. The rejection relies on the plainly visible large round blobs, changed mark shapes and relative lengths, not guessed text.
